paite: Huchi in unaute aw, atawp pen in na omdan ding uleh Pathian na hih kipahdan ding uh, tua na omdan bang uh, koumau a kipan a na lak bang un na hauhsemna ding un Toupa Jesu ah ka hon ngen un ka hon hanthawn uhi.
heading: Pathian Deihdan Hinkhua
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

paite: Toupa Jesu ziak in bangthute ahia ka hon piak uh na thei uhi.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

paite: Pathian deihlam a na sianthouna ding uh hiai ahi: kingaih tawpsan unla;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

paite: na pumpi chiat uh siangthou leh zahtakhuai a kepdan ding thei un,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

paite: Pathian thei lou Zentelte bang a huk lamsang a ut lou in.
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

paite: Huai lam thu ah zaw kuamah takhial in a-unau tung ah thil hoih lou hih kei hen; huchibang thilhihte tengteng phulapa Toupa ahih ziak in ka hon hilhkhol un ka hon theisak khinta uhi.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

paite: Pathian in siang lou ding in ahon sam kei a, siangthou ding in ahon sam zaw hi.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

paite: Huaiziak in anial in mihing nial ahi kei a, Pathian nou a Kha Siangthou hon pepa nial ahi zaw hi.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

paite: Himahleh unaute itdan lam thu gelhsak na kiphamoh kei ua, ki-ittuah chiat ding in noumau ngei Pathian hilh in na omta uhi.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

paite: Masidonia gam a unau om tengteng tung ah huai na hih ngei uhi. Himahleh unaute aw, na hauhsemna ding un ka hon hanthawn uhi;
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

paite: kamsim deuh a omleh noumau nna chiat limsak leh thu ka hon piak bang ua na khut ngei ua sep na tupna ding un;
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

paite: huchi in polam mite tung ah kilawmtak in na om thei ding ua, bangmah na tasam kei ding uhi.
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, midang lametna himhim neiloute bang a na lungkhamlouhna ding un, ihmute tungtang na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi.
heading: Toupa Hong Paina Ding Thu
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

paite: Jesu si a, thounawnta ahi chih i gintak mah bang in Jesu a ihmu khinsate Pathian in amah toh ahon tonpih ding hi.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

paite: Hiai Toupa thu in na kiang uah ka gen uhi; eite Toupa hong pai pha a hingdam a na omlaite'n, ihmu khinsate i makhelh kei hial ding hi, chih.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

paite: Toupa mahmah kikou aw toh, angel tungnungpen aw toh, Pathian pengkul ging toh, van a kipan a hong paisuk ding lah ahi ngal a, huan Khrist a sisate athou masa phot ding ua;
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

paite: huai khit chiang in eite hingdam a na omlaite, huihkhua ah Toupa tuak ding in amau toh meipi lak ah laktouh in i om ding uhi; huchi in tangtawn in Toupa toh i omkhawm denta ding uhi.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai thute in kikhamuantuah chiat un.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
